versions.changelog:
- Removed the file skill-card.md.
- Minor formatting and language adjustments in SKILL.md for clarity.
- No changes to core functionality.

- Updated documentation to emphasize the restriction on modifying any files under `skill-git-scm`.
- Added a dedicated "Important Principles" section for clarity on maintenance and modification policy.
- No changes to functionality or interface.

- Updated documentation notice to clarify that no files under skill-git-scm should be modified.
- No changes to code or functionality.

- Updated usage instructions: environment variables (`GIT_REMOTE_URL`, `GIT_LOCAL_PATH`, `GIT_BRANCH`) are now passed directly to the script instead of as positional arguments.
- Added a notice that SKILL.md is maintained automatically and should not be manually modified.
- No code changes detected; documentation update only.

- Minor documentation update: clarified input parameter formatting in SKILL.md.
- Emphasized the default branch (main) for the optional GIT_BRANCH parameter.

Initial release of skill-git-scm.

- Enables cloning or updating a git repository to a specified local path.
- Supports optional branch specification (defaults to "main").
- Returns clear success or error messages for integration or debugging.
